facts.fact: David 早上八点被静电下传来的微弱声音吵醒;那声音反复念着「Find the receiver. Make it real.」
facts.anchor:
David woke up at eight a.m. to a faint voice speaking from underneath the static.


“Find the receiver. Make it real. Find the receiver. Make it real.”

facts.fact: David 爬过地下室地毯,拿起 Erin 留在地毯上的空白 VHS 磁带装进 VCR,按下录制。
facts.anchor: He reached for a blank VHS tape that Erin had left out on the carpet and then loaded it into the VCR. He pressed record.

facts.fact: 两人都认出屏幕上的声音是 Erin 自己的——从她那台旧 Toshiba 的另一侧传来。
facts.anchor: That it was her. Her own voice, speaking from somewhere else, from the other side of her old Toshiba.

facts.fact: 静电开始重组成形,「另一个 Erin」的脸从静电中探出来,像被 pinscreen 推出。
facts.anchor: The two of them watched the television screen as Erin—another Erin—appeared, her face now poking through the static, as if pushed through a pinscreen.

facts.fact: 广播消退:Erin 的影像逐渐退回静电,屏幕上她的声音越来越轻直至完全消失。
facts.anchor: The broadcast faded. Erin’s image gradually receded back into static and her voice on the screen grew quieter until it disappeared entirely.

facts.fact: David 等了整整一分钟才按下 VCR 停止键并弹出录像带——他成功录下了来自 Public Access Afterworld 的又一次广播。
facts.anchor: David waited a full minute before he pressed the stop button on the VCR. He ejected the tape and weighed it in his hands, as if he couldn’t believe the VHS was his to hold. He’d managed to record it. To capture another broadcast from Public Access Afterworld.

facts.fact: David 说「It’s real」「It’s really real」,称刚才看到的没有别的解释、是 impossible 的。
facts.anchor: “It’s real,” he said. There was something celebratory in his voice. “It’s really real. There’s no other explanation. What we just saw…that was impossible.”

facts.fact: Erin 不需要这种确认——她几周前就已知道这一切是真实的,而且正发生在她身上。
facts.anchor: She didn’t need such confirmation. She’d known for weeks now what David was only just realizing. That all of this was very real, and that it was happening to her.
